newsitem.title: INDIA: India copper suffers setback as players sit it out.
newsitem.headline: India copper suffers setback as players sit it out.

text.p: Copper prices suffered a setback at the improved level on local markets on Friday, dealers said, though other base metals were steady in thin activity.
Volumes were dull as major players awaited the announcement of sale prices by state-owned agencies for February.
Copper fell by 100 rupees to 12,750 rupees per quintal as industrial demand petered out while higher prices attracted profit-taking.
"Some traders were predicting that state-owned Hindustan Copper Ltd. may hike selling prices for February while some traders were predicting reduction," one broker said.
Zinc was steady at 6,750 rupees per quintal.

Lead was available at 4,550 rupees per quintal as was tin at 34,400 rupees and nickel at 36,500 rupees per quintal in limited activity. Aluminium was quiet at 7,250 rupees per quintal but trading was nominal.
